commit_message: GATE-01: conformance foundation — schemas, real vectors, TS+Python runners
scope_completed: Created JSON schemas in conformance/schemas/ for NodeId derivation, advertisement vectors, and CBOR vectors
Created 5 real Ed25519 advertisement vectors (valid, invalid signature, expired, malformed, sequence rollback) with fixed timestamps for reproducibility
Created TypeScript vector runner (conformance/runners/ts-vector-runner.ts) that reads all vector files and verifies each against the reference implementation — 9/9 pass
Created independent Python verifier (conformance/runners/py_vector_verifier.py) implementing BLAKE3-256, RFC 4648 base32, Ed25519 verification, and canonical CBOR from scratch — 9/9 pass
Fixed V-NODEID-003.json (string lengths were wrong from manual counting; regenerated programmatically)
Created conformance/requirements.txt for Python verifier dependencies (blake3, cbor2, pynacl)
TypeScript and Python consume IDENTICAL vector files and produce IDENTICAL verification results
commands_run: JSON parse validation for every conformance/vectors/*.json
known_limitations: Schemas for link handshake, topology hint, route, circuit, and gateway negotiation are not yet created (the wire formats are not yet ratified — GATE-03+)
The Python verifier does not yet verify link handshake vectors (ADR-0016 is still a PROPOSAL — no handshake vectors exist)
Cross-language conformance is proven for NodeId, CBOR, and advertisement vectors only — not for link handshake, routing, or circuit formats (which don't exist yet)
GATE-03 is BLOCKED on ADR-0016 approval (3-message transcript-binding handshake)
